args.evidence: not_null test on fct_orders.region_name failed with 14625 nulls out of 15000 rows. In fct_orders model, region_name is derived via left join to dim_customers using `on o.order_key = c.customer_key`. This join condition is incorrect; it should join on o.customer_key = c.customer_key. Query `select count(*) from staging.stg_orders o join marts.dim_customers c on o.order_key = c.customer_key` returned only 375 matches, leaving 14625 rows with null region_name. Upstream tables have correct row counts and no nulls, so the problem originates from the join logic in fct_orders model.
